item.title: Most Stable Raspberry Pi? 81% Better NTP with Thermal Management
item.description:
📝 This post details how I achieved an 81% reduction in frequency variability and 77% reduction in frequency standard deviation through a combination of CPU core pinning and thermal stabilization. But here’s the key insight: the system clock is ultimately derived from a crystal oscillator, and crystal oscillator frequency is temperature-dependent. The CPU frequency scaling was one factor, but the underlying problem was that temperature changes were affecting the crystal oscillator itself.
🔗 Read more: https://austinsnerdythings.com/2025/11/24/worlds-most-stable-raspberry-pi-81-better-ntp-with-thermal-management/

item.title: Human brains are preconfigured with instructions for understanding the world
item.description:
📝 UC Santa Cruz researchers used brain organoids to study the brain’s earliest electrical activity. Understanding early brain patterns could have important implications for diagnosing and treating developmental brain disorders. Researchers at the University of California, Santa Cruz, are using tiny models of human brain tissue, called organoids, to study the earliest moments of electrical activity in the brain.
🔗 Read more: https://news.ucsc.edu/2025/11/sharf-preconfigured-brain/
